tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250bstan 'bar ma bzhugs so// 1$0000300sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug tor thams cad skyob// 'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub 'od srungs dang*// shākya thub pa go tam lha yi lha// sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can don du bdag gis sngon// dka' ba gang zhig spyad gyur dang*// bdag gi bde ba btang ba yis// bstan pa yun ring 'bar gyur cig /ngas sngon nad pa'i ched dag tu// rang gi 'tsho ba yongs btang bas// sems can phongs pa bskyabs pa'i phyir// bstan pa= bu dang bu mo chung ma dang*// nor dang glang chen shing rta dang*// rin chen byang chub phyir btang bas// bstan pa= bdag gis sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas// nyan thos pha dang ma dang ni// drang srong dag la mchod byas pas// bstan pa= bskal pa bye ba du mar bdag /sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong gyur cing*// byang chub don du thos btsal pas// bstan pa= bdag gis tshul khrims brtul zhugs dang*// dka' thub yun ring brten byas shing*// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas ngas mchod pas// bstan pa= bdag sngon brtson 'grus dang ldan pas// rtag tu brtan cing pha rol gnon// sems can thams cad bsgral don du// bdag bstan yun ring 'bar gyur cig /bzod brtul rtag tu brtan byas shing*// sems can nyon mongs snyigs ma yi// sems can ngan bzod byas gyur pas// bstan pa= bsam gtan rnam thar gzugs med dang*// ting 'dzin gang gā'i bye snyed pa// bsgoms pa de'i mthus bdag gi ni// bstan pa= ye shes don du bdag gis sngon// dka' thub nags dag brten byas shing*// bstan bcos du ma nyer bstan pas// bdag gi bstan pa 'bar gyur cig /brtse ba'i rgyu yis sha khrag dang*// 'tsho ba yongs su btang gyur cing*// yan lag nying lag btang ba yis// chos tshul rnam par 'phel gyur cig /bdag sngon sdig pa'i sems can rnams// byams pas gsal bar smin byas shing*// theg pa gsum la rab bkod pas// chos kyi chos sbyin rgyas gyur cig

/bdag sngon thabs shes gyur pa na// sems can lta ngan las bsgral cing*// yang dag lta la bkod byas pas// chos ni rnam par 'phel gyur cig /bdag gis sems can bsdu dngos bzhis// nyon mongs me las thar byas shing*// bdag gis 'phel sdig pham byas pas// bdag 'khor yun ring gnas gyur cig /bdag gis mu stegs can gzhan dag /lta ba'i chu las bsgral byas shing*// yang dag lta la bkod gyur pas// bdag 'khor rtag tu gus gyur cig /bstan pa yun ring 'bar gyur cig /
'di ni zla ba sgron me'i mdo las gsungs pa'o/// / ༈ dpe tshan 'di sngon med gsar bzhag gis lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
